title: Graduating in 1947 and joining the musicians' union
summary: Ford graduated in 1947 after playing the prom with the Joe Jones big band, and joined the union at 16.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Probably it was 46, something right? 46 or 45. I don't believe it was 47 because I graduated from high school in 47 with this band, Joe Jones, this big band, we played for the prom. And that 46 dollars, it was six dollars then, put me in the union. So I've been in the union long enough to be a lifetime member, but I'm not old enough. And I was joining the union when I was 16. See, which is all, next year it'll be 30 years. But I believe you have to be 65. See, and I'm 45, so I have 20 more years. And I've been in the union almost 30 years. Did you go old now? Yeah, but I'm not in there long enough. I mean, I'm not old enough. I'm in there long enough because there are guys that haven't been in there as long as me, but they're old enough, you see.
